clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in 
me by the Constitution and statutes, in­
cluding Title I of the First War Powers 
Act, 1941 (55 Stat. 838), and as President 
of the United States, it is hereby ordered 
as follows;
There are transferred from the War 
Department to the Administrator of 
Civil Aeronautics, Department of Com­
merce,. (1) all air-navigation, air-traf- 
flc -control, airways- communications,
and r meteorological facilities of the 
United States necessary to the operation 
of civil aircraft of the United States in 
international air commerce at Tehran, 
Abadan, and Jask, Iran, (2) all other 
property of the United States located at 
the site of any of the said facilities, in­
cluding housing, other structures, equip­
ment, and vehicles, necessary to the op­
eration and maintenance of such facili­
ties, (3) all functions of operation and 
maintenance of such facilities, and (4) 
so much of the funds available or to be 
made available for the use of the War 
Department in the operation and main­
tenance of such facilities as the Direc­
tor of the Bureau of the Budget shall 
determine to relate to the said functions.
This order shall become effective on 
January. 1 , 1946.
